staff.name: Kris Otto
staff.title: Founder · Esthetician & Cosmetologist
staff.bio: Kris is a well-known esthetician and cosmetologist who has worked in the DMV for many years. He founded Buddies in 2022 after starting out as a nail technician and moving into waxing, and he works hard to deliver the highest quality work to every client.

staff.name: Stephanus Rensburg
staff.title: Massage Therapist
staff.bio: Stephanus has more than 20 years of massage experience on two continents. Our most requested massage therapist, he has been with Buddies since 2022. His specialties are therapeutic and Swedish massage.

staff.name: Michael Ney
staff.title: Licensed Massage Therapist
staff.bio: Michael is a licensed massage therapist with over five years of experience in deep tissue, trigger point therapy and Swedish massage. He tailors every session to what you need, whether that's relieving tension, targeting problem areas or simply helping you relax. Fluent in English and Portuguese.

staff.name: Martin Lacy
staff.title: Esthetician
staff.bio: Martin is the newest esthetician on the Buddies team. Through his own techniques and a personalized approach, he takes care to address exactly what your skin needs.

staff.name: Hoang Pham
staff.title: Nail Technician · Massage Therapist · Esthetician
staff.bio: Hoang is an experienced, talented nail technician who has been with Buddies since 2022, and clients love his nail design work. He is also a massage therapist and an esthetician for men's waxing.

staff.name: Mimi Nguyen
staff.title: Nail Technician

staff.name: Don Tran
staff.title: Cosmetologist & Barber

staff.name: Giavanni Smith

staff.name: Jay Tran
